scientific_question: Can generated whole-product graphs be constrained to program- and role-local chemistry observed in the training fold without selecting a finite component vocabulary?
nonclaims: Training-supported local chemistry is not synthesis success, stability, safety, activity or route closure.
An unsupported local pattern is an abstention under this bounded policy, not proof that the pattern is chemically impossible.
The policy stores no component identity, component fingerprint or complete molecular fragment.
This policy does not replace the raw exact-L1 result and does not select candidates.
